Bilingual Assholes Study 2: Graphs

morgan moyer

2026-05-15

Exclusions

First remove the non-italian speaking participants

d <- df %>% 
  filter(!Participant %in% non_its$Participant) %>% 
  filter(!Participant %in% low_reading$Participant)

# How many people were removed?
length(unique(df$Participant)) - length(unique(d$Participant))
## [1] 82
# How many people reamining?
length(unique(d$Participant))/length(unique(df$Participant))*100
## [1] 61.86047
length(unique(d$Participant))
## [1] 133

Summary Stats

agr <- d %>% 
  group_by(Valence) %>% 
  summarize(MeanAcceptability = mean(SliderResponse),
            SD = sd(SliderResponse))
print(agr)
## # A tibble: 2 × 3
##   Valence MeanAcceptability    SD
##   <chr>               <dbl> <dbl>
## 1 neg                  48.4  33.9
## 2 pos                  71.8  27.9
sub <- d[!is.na(d$Valence), ]
nrow(sub)
## [1] 8040
nrow(d)
## [1] 8040
length(unique(sub$Participant))
## [1] 133
ggplot(d, aes(SliderResponse, fill = Valence)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bad"="#F52731","good"= "#27BEF5", "neutral"="#8E27F5"))
## Warning: No shared levels found between `names(values)` of the manual scale and the
## data's fill values.
## No shared levels found between `names(values)` of the manual scale and the
## data's fill values.

ggplot(d, aes(SliderResponse,fill=Valence)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .5) +
  facet_wrap(~Valence) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bad"="#F52731","good"= "#27BEF5", "neutral"="#8E27F5"))
## Warning: No shared levels found between `names(values)` of the manual scale and the
## data's fill values.
## No shared levels found between `names(values)` of the manual scale and the
## data's fill values.

  # scale_fill_manual(values = vaPalette)
agr <- d %>% 
  group_by(Nativeness,ContextCondition) %>% 
  filter(TrialType == "test") %>% 
  reframe(MeanAcceptability = mean(SliderResponse), 
          CILow = ci.low(SliderResponse), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(SliderResponse)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanAcceptability - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanAcceptability + CIHigh)


dodge = position_dodge(.9)
ggplot(data=agr, aes(x=ContextCondition,y=MeanAcceptability,fill=Nativeness)) +
  geom_bar(position=dodge,stat="identity",color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=YMin,ymax=YMax),width=.25,position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = vaPalette) +
   theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

Remove Low-reading proficiency participants

d <- df %>% 
  filter((!Participant %in% non_its$Participant) &
           (!Participant %in% low_reading$Participant))

# How many people were removed?
length(unique(df$Participant)) - length(unique(d$Participant))
## [1] 82
# How many people reamining?
length(unique(d$Participant))/length(unique(df$Participant))*100
## [1] 61.86047
length(unique(d$Participant))
## [1] 133
